subject: SuperKalam reviews: 2 critical reviews without a reply

reviews.evidence: unable to access the feature I paid for
reviews.text: I regret purchasing the SuperKalam subscription because the app is not available on laptops, and when I log in through Google Chrome, many of its features are disabled. This is really disappointing. At the very least, all the features should be available when accessing the platform through a browser. I am extremely disappointed with this experience. I do will not renew or purchase another subscription in the future . My money feels wasted because I unable to access the feature I paid for
